decisions.statement: An inherited property is restated only to narrow that property.
A restatement moving no field in the narrowing direction is refused.
A value moving out of the commit or out of the open narrows.
A unique kind moving toward `page-property` narrows.
A declaration is judged against the nearest declaration above that declaration.
Which page types stand above a page type is walked through `extends-type`.
A page type is judged when the change has that page type or a property that type declares.
A page type under a judged page type is judged as well.
A restatement that loosens is passed over here.
Its fields are not judged here.
A page type saying one property twice over is not judged here.

definition: the check refusing a restatement of an inherited property that narrows nothing
